world: an ancient overgrown forest with giant mossy trees, broken stone ruins and arches covered in vines, soft green light filtering through the canopy, ferns, wildflowers and small streams

b-goblin.describe: a small mossy forest goblin with big pointed ears, leaf and moss clothing, a little wooden club, sly grin

b-boar.describe: a huge armored wild boar with thorny moss-covered bark-like plates on its back, curved tusks, angry glowing eyes

b-elder.describe: an ancient giant treant, a walking tree with a wise bearded face in the bark, thick twisted trunk-body and branch arms covered in moss and hanging vines, small white flowers and mushrooms, a glowing green heart-light in its chest, roots for feet
